limitations: Memory currently has quarantine only for lesson candidates. Explicit persona/institutional entry quarantine returns unavailable with entry_quarantine_not_supported_by_memory_owner; this task adds no privileged owner route or local flag.
This is local source/in-process HTTP evidence with test-only fixtures; it does not prove hosted deployment, production credentials, PostgreSQL restart durability or execute-plans delivery.
Unscoped legacy institutional or persona entries fail closed; they are not silently treated as shared tenant data.
Viewer reads may enter the BFF read surface but Memory/Governance can refuse them; BFF never substitutes a privileged Memory principal.
